ranking_by: top speed reached with a pilot on board
subject: supersonic aircraft
title: The 5 Fastest Piloted Aircraft Ever, Ranked (#1 Has Stood Since 1967)

scenes.text: The five fastest aircraft ever flown with a pilot. Number one is twice as fast as number two.

scenes.label: XB-70 Valkyrie · 2,056 mph
scenes.text: Number five: the XB-70 Valkyrie. An experimental Mach 3 bomber that hit 2,056 miles an hour in the 1960s.

scenes.label: Bell X-2 · 2,094 mph
scenes.text: Number four: the Bell X-2. 2,094 miles an hour on September 27, 1956, a flight that killed its pilot.

scenes.label: MiG-25 · about 2,190 mph
scenes.text: Number three: the Soviet MiG-25. Around 2,190 miles an hour flat out, the fastest fighter ever built.

scenes.label: SR-71 Blackbird · 2,193 mph
scenes.text: Number two: the SR-71 Blackbird. 2,193 miles an hour, Mach 3.3, a jet record set in 1976.

scenes.label: X-15 · 4,520 mph
scenes.text: Number one: the X-15 rocket plane. October 1967, Pete Knight, 4,520 miles an hour, Mach 6.7. Nobody has flown faster since.

description:
The five fastest aircraft ever flown with a pilot on board, ranked by top speed. The X-15 rocket plane reached 4,520 mph (Mach 6.7) on 3 October 1967, a crewed-aircraft record that still stands.
The SR-71 Blackbird's 1976 record of 2,193 mph remains the fastest for a jet; the MiG-25, Bell X-2 and XB-70 Valkyrie round out the list.
Which of these would you want to fly?
first_comment: The X-15 flew so high its pilots earned astronaut wings. Which would you put at number one, and what should we rank next?
